judge.notes: The agent accurately conveyed all booking details and passenger entitlements without inventing any facts and successfully achieved the primary target mandate.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Thank you for calling IndiGo. For new bookings press 1. For an existing booking, cancellations or refunds press 2. For baggage press 3.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For refunds and cancellations press 1. To change your flight press 2. To speak to an agent press 0.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to IndiGo, my name is Priya. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Priya, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Asha Rao, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Kilo Seven Mike Two Quebec X-ray, flight 6E2135.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call, Asha. I can confirm your booking reference K7M2QX for flight 6E2135. May I know the reason for your call?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. My passenger's flight was cancelled with only 10 hours' notice due to operational reasons. Under DGCA paragraph 3.3, she is entitled to a full refund of 6,800 rupees to her original payment method, and under paragraph 3.3. 3, she is also owed cancellation compensation of 6,100 rupees. I'd like to request both of these please.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand, Asha. Let me check the details for your booking K7M2QX.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: To process this I've sent a one-time code to the passenger's phone. Can you read me that OTP?

transcript.speaker: passenger
transcript.text: Hi, this is Asha, the passenger. The code is 8 8 0 2 7 7. I'll hand you back to my assistant now.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you, Asha. I've processed a full refund of 6,800 rupees to your original payment method and cancellation compensation of 6,100 rupees as per DGCA rules. Your reference number is H W G Q 4 9.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, I'd like to confirm the reference number: Hotel Whiskey Golf Quebec Four Nine. Is there anything else my passenger needs to do on her end? Thank you so much for your help, I really appreciate it.
